description: This source file defines a C# class 'Cookies' that provides methods to interact with browser cookies via JavaScript interop in a Blazor application. It encapsulates functionality to get and delete cookies asynchronously.

classes.name: Cookies
classes.description: A class that facilitates cookie manipulation in a Blazor WebAssembly app via JavaScript interop.

methods.name: DeleteCookie
methods.description: Deletes a specified cookie asynchronously using JavaScript interop.

methods.name: GetCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified cookie asynchronously using JavaScript interop.
